v23_fixture_claim.description: Summons two named pigs and claims one as the fixture 'source'. Expect a FIXTURE claim record with the uuid and tag devtool.fx.v23_fixtures.source, and the placeholder resolving in the NBT lookup.

v23_duplicate_control.description: Claims the same handle again. Expect a refusal and the bundle halting before its second marker.

v23_fixture_far.description: Teleports 600 blocks away so the fixtures' chunk unloads, waits, lists, and returns. Expect fixture list to say state=unloaded, and the absence assertion to report unloaded rather than absent.

v23_forged_control.description: Strips the ownership tag from the source pig, then clears all: the clear must be refused with reason=notOwned and the pig left alive. Puts the tag back and clears again: now the pig is removed and its uuid logged. The bystander, never claimed, is untouched throughout.

v23_cleanup.description: Removes the bystander by name and stops the session.
